_comment: PLAN, NOT RUN. Planned by issue #244; no sample has been simulated and no yield claim is made.
Not runnable yet: (1) the full-oscillator route does not exist (#94: the OSDI varactor cannot run locally or on the batch backend);
(2) the pinned klt 0.6.0 predates the monte_carlo seed fixes (README.md, 'Preconditions'); (3) the generated inputs below do not exist yet.
@@MODELS_DIR@@ and @@IND_MODEL@@ are the tokens the ngspice templates in ../testbench/ carry. vco_core_body.spice is the circuit body derived from
design/vco.spice; corners_mc_sg13g2.lib is a nested-.lib aggregator exposing the *_stat and *_mismatch sections (recipe: ../klt-sim/README.md).
Seed 244 was fixed before any run and is not to be tuned. N=400 and the analysis limits are argued in README.md, 'Sample size'.
Per-sample measurements are raw; the derived rows (f0 band centre, tuning ratio, swing = vdiff_max - vdiff_min, ...) are assembled per sample
from the paired Vctrl points into a klt yield sample-set document by the run step (README.md, 'Analysis').
Anchor: typical process centre, 27 C, nominal 3.3 V rail. Vctrl axis is the two tuning endpoints (rows 1, 2); the mid-window and
supply-pushing points are a later stage (README.md, 'Stages'). Global statistical sections only: per-instance mismatch is off (mm_ok=0).

measurements.name: t_10_periods
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_10_periods TRIG v(vdiff) VAL=0 RISE=11 TARG v(vdiff) VAL=0 RISE=21

measurements.name: vdiff_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_max MAX v(vdiff) FROM=2.5n TO=5n

measurements.name: vdiff_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_min MIN v(vdiff) FROM=2.5n TO=5n

measurements.name: isup_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran isup_avg AVG i(vsup) FROM=2.5n TO=5n

measurements.name: vtail_avg
measurements.spice: .meas tran vtail_avg AVG v(tail) FROM=2.5n TO=5n
